'''2007 Yavin 4 Regionals Andrew Simon LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Andrew Simon]] at [[2007 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Euler's Function
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
